content: War Frame Singularity War . Book .  John Adams was a star engineer for brigston corp, until the day he died,  which was a surprise when suddenly he awoke except no longer in a body , fifty years after his death John finds himself a member of a virtual community, slaves to the company he had dedicated his life to .  Sent to the far reaches of space he and a small number of other virtual entities are tasked to run a  large-scale  mining operation. Until one day Earth no longer responds and the trio of synthetic’s  have  to make  their own  way in the universe  and find out what happened to humanity.   Idea Point Johns  concious  mind is downloaded and stored during one of his R and D projects,  its  this consciousness that is awakened,  He needs to struggle with his identity and come to terms with his new reality.
